limitations: Tool MIT license does not license Blizzard assets or source site data. Local analysis only; extracted assets not added to repository.
Wago target-build table exports are external source assertions, retained with URL and content hash; selected mapping independently agrees with extracted terrain area IDs and positions.
File names assigned locally; physical tile is established by MCNK world positions and target AreaTable rather than inferring undocumented MAID orientation.
Chunk framing and file hashes do not prove collision completeness or traversability.
WDT MAI2 chunk semantics not implemented by pinned wow.export parser.
Placement dependencies need M2 collision arrays, WMO groups/doodad sets and transforms, liquids/holes, boundary stitching, dynamic exclusions, and native walkability checks before route publication.
